The '''Star Cluster Casino job''' was a heist carried out by professional thieves during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The thieves uploaded a program into the computers of the [[Star Cluster Casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] which allowed for them to win massive payouts at seemingly random intervals. Once they had collected their money, the thieves disappeared, and [[Casino/Legends|casino]] authorities did not realize they had been robbed until much later. During the war it was widely considered to be the most notorious heist in years.
